title: Inside the Mystic Fire Altar
summary: With Shangguan Ce away from his post, Gui Li slips into the Mystic Fire forbidden ground, a great altar students may not enter, hoping it holds the ancient Wu clan's texts. The fire power inside is so strong he must resist it at every step, and a red light there carries an evil force almost equal to his Soul-Devouring Stick, nearly taking over his mind. Beneath the altar is an active volcano. Xiao Hui seems to absorb some of the power, and a Crimson Flame Beast, which Gui Li takes for the spirit beast guarding the formation, attacks him. At the valley gate the fish-men attack, and Shangguan Ce arrives and steadies the fight at once; Li Xun says he once cowed sixty-three alien clans. Through an interpreter the fish-men demand the killer of their chief, killed after a secret meeting with Fen Xiang, while Li Xun says a disciple lost control and killed one of them first. Shangguan Ce goes to examine the fish-men's bodies.
